clue.text: No voters instructed and forced

parts.note: cons are votes against, so people voting no are the cons
to be instructed is to be trained

explanation.surface: Voters told to say no were coerced into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone constrained is compelled or obliged to act, a straight synonym of forced.

clue.text: Papal court is somewhat mercurial

indicators.note: somewhat says only a portion of the following word is used, its middle letters

explanation.surface: A remark that the Vatican's administration is a little volatile.
explanation.definitionFit: The Curia is the body of departments through which the Pope governs the Catholic Church.

clue.text: Sadly remembering losing cat in accident

indicators.note: letters involved in an accident are smashed up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone grieving, recalling a pet lost in a road accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' looks like a deletion signal for 'cat', but all nine letters of 'losing cat' are the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Nostalgia is wistful, bittersweet longing for the past, a sad kind of remembering.

clue.text: Modern film of alcoholic following end of treatment

indicators.note: following places the drinker after the letter picked from treatment
the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: an alkie is a slang word for an alcoholic

explanation.surface: A recent film about a drinker who relapses after rehab ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A talkie was a film with a soundtrack, the modern innovation of the late 1920s.

clue.text: Part of circular curve

definitions.meaning: a segment of the circumference of a circle

explanation.surface: A section of a round shape that bends.
explanation.definitionFit: A geometric term for a piece of a circle's edge, and more loosely any curving line.

clue.text: Tell a ranter off

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong or out of place, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to tell off a person who rants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tell ... off' reads as one phrasal verb, but 'off' belongs to the anagram and 'Tell' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate is to recount or relate a story, which is to tell it.

clue.text: Reprimand what workers may be doing on a Friday

definitions.text: what workers may be doing on a Friday
definitions.meaning: wearing casual clothes on a dress-down Friday at the office

explanation.surface: A rebuke, and what office staff do at the week's end.
explanation.walkthrough: Many offices allow casual clothes on Fridays, so staff are dressing down.
explanation.definitionFit: A scolding is called a dressing-down idiomatically; literally the phrase means wearing less formal clothes.

clue.text: Progressively surrender playing cards held

parts.note: to surrender something is to hand it over
the cards a player holds are their hand

explanation.surface: Steadily giving up the cards one is playing with.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbing hand over hand means moving one hand past the other, so it describes steady, step-by-step progress.

clue.text: Those regularly in salesroom should and can, under pressure

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter, here the 2nd, 4th and so on through the two words

explanation.surface: Regular visitors to a salesroom should cope when the pressure is on.
explanation.walkthrough: The alternate letters run continuously across both words: A,E,R,O from salesroom then S,O,L from should.
explanation.definitionFit: A spray canister holds its contents under pressure, released through a valve.

clue.text: Cut volume in what NHS provides

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: the National Health Service, Britain's public health system, provides care

explanation.surface: Complaint about cuts in the amount of health care provided.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve is to cut, as with meat or wood.

clue.text: Mad racist thrown out for overemotional behaviour

indicators.note: thrown out suggests the letters are tossed about and land in a new order

explanation.surface: A deranged bigot is ejected for making a scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Histrionics or theatrics: exaggerated, showy displays of feeling.

clue.text: Final few candidates drink and heel over

parts.note: a short is a small strong drink such as a spirit
a ship that heels over leans, or lists

explanation.surface: The remaining job applicants have a drink and topple over.
explanation.definitionFit: The select few applicants kept for final consideration after the first round of elimination.

clue.text: Fool — like son

parts.note: as means like, in the same way

explanation.surface: A father says his son is as foolish as he is.
explanation.definitionFit: An ass is a stupid person, from the donkey's reputation.

clue.text: Sign to get round a bad-tempered woman

indicators.note: the sign gets round, so encloses, the following letter

parts.note: Virgo is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: An astrologer's sign needed to placate an ill-humoured woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A virago is a domineering, violent or bad-tempered woman, a shrew.

clue.text: Rook greatly annoys park attendants

parts.note: R is the chess notation abbreviation for rook
to anger someone is to annoy them greatly

explanation.surface: A noisy crow is a nuisance to the park wardens.
explanation.definitionFit: Rangers are the wardens who patrol and look after parks and forests.

clue.text: Navy's after style that's new

indicators.note: the navy is after, so placed behind, the word for style

parts.note: a mode is a style or fashion
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A fashion following the naval look is the latest thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something modern is up to date, recent, rather than old.

clue.text: Children's author having endless blockage

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a barrier is something that blocks the way

explanation.surface: A writer for children suffering from never-ending writer's block.
explanation.definitionFit: J. M. Barrie wrote Peter Pan, a classic children's story.

clue.text: Fled Islamic republic without capital

indicators.note: capital here is the capital or first letter of the word, which is dropped

parts.note: Iran is officially the Islamic Republic of Iran

explanation.surface: Someone escaped from Iran without any money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' suggests Tehran or money but means the initial letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ran is the past tense of run, and to run away is to flee.

clue.text: Charles X has editor humbled

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A king called Charles the Tenth has been put in his place by an editor.
explanation.definitionFit: To be chastened is to be subdued or made humble by rebuke or misfortune.

clue.text: Splendidly old British left in New York

indicators.note: in places the three letters inside the city's abbreviation

explanation.surface: An old Briton living in New York is doing very nicely.
explanation.definitionFit: Nobly can mean in a grand, magnificent or splendid manner.

clue.text: Make a change to last word, fourth letter

parts.note: amen is the word said at the end of a prayer
D is the fourth letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: An editor altering the closing word, the fourth letter of it.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend a text is to alter or correct it.

clue.text: Pair half of duck with a whole one

indicators.note: half of a four-letter word is its first two letters

parts.note: a whole duck in cricket is a score of nothing, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A couple consisting of half a duck plus one complete one.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a duck is a score of zero, so a whole one is O.
explanation.definitionFit: A duo is two people or things together, a couple.

clue.text: Area in Belgium initially in dispute with many ethnicities

indicators.note: in places those letters inside the word for an argument

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or dispute

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of the country's name

explanation.surface: A region of Belgium caught up in an ethnic quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A rainbow nation or coalition is one made up of many different races, like the colours of the spectrum.

clue.text: Host snidely stirring in an insincere manner

indicators.note: stirring mixes the letters up into a new order

explanation.surface: A presenter making snide remarks to cause trouble while being two-faced.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting dishonestly means without sincerity or truthfulness.
